summary_1line: Karna conquers many kingdoms for Duryodhana, is honored in Hastinapura, and advises a grand sacrifice after priests forbid Duryodhana from performing the Rajasuya.

image_candidates.scene_text: Karna returns triumphant to Hastinapura as Duryodhana publicly praises him before assembled kings in the royal court.
Karna bows at the feet of the blind king Dhritarashtra and Gandhari in the inner palace as they embrace him like a son.
Artisans forge a golden plough for Duryodhana’s planned Vaishnava sacrifice while priests and courtiers look on.
